title: [WIP] Remove playground project and related studio deployments
body:
## Plan to Remove Playground Project and Studio Deployment

- [x] Remove the `apps/playground` directory entirely
- [x] Remove playground-related scripts from root `package.json`
- [x] Update `README.md` to remove studio deployment link (`play.objectstack.ai`)
- [x] Update `docs/index.md` to remove studio deployment link
- [x] Update `docs/guide/studio.md` to remove studio deployment link
- [x] Update `docs/ROADMAP.md` to remove playground references
- [x] Update `CONTRIBUTING.md` to remove playground references
- [x] Update `VERIFICATION.md` to remove playground references
- [x] Update `docs/lazy-loaded-plugins.md` to remove playground references
- [x] Build and verify the remaining packages still work

## Summary

Successfully removed the `apps/playground` project and all references to the studio deployment URL (`play.objectstack.ai`) from the repository. 

### Changes Made:
1. **Deleted**: Entire `apps/playground` directory (75+ files)
2. **Updated package.json**: Removed `playground` and `dev` scripts, changed `dev` to use `prototype` instead
3. **Updated documentation**: 
   - Replaced studio deployment links with references to the `@object-ui/designer` package
   - Updated examples to use `pnpm designer` or `pnpm prototype` instead of `pnpm playground`
   - Removed all references to `play.objectstack.ai`
4. **Verified**: All builds and tests pass successfully (95 tests passing across 16 test files)
